name: qlrisk_price_non_deliverable_forward
title: Price a NonDeliverableForward
description:
Price one Non-Deliverable Forward (qlrisk NonDeliverableForward).
Inputs (* required, name=default): maturity*, notional=1000000, forward_rate, pair, currency=USD. In `advanced` also: effective_date, spot, domestic_curve, foreign_curve, foreign_rate_pct, position.
Example: {"maturity": "1Y", "notional": 1000000} gives NPV 0.00 USD (sample market valued 2026-10-09).
